question_cn: 双象对光杆王，将死的核心思路是：
question_en: Two bishops vs. lone king — the core idea for checkmate is:

options.text_cn: 两象控制两条斜线，配合王把对方王逼到角落将死
options.text_en: Bishops control two diagonals, cooperate with king to drive enemy king to corner

options.text_cn: 两象互相保护，等对方王走近
options.text_en: Bishops protect each other and wait for the enemy king

options.text_cn: 双象可以单独将死，不需要王
options.text_en: Two bishops can checkmate alone without the king

options.text_cn: 把对方王逼到棋盘中心将死
options.text_en: Drive the enemy king to the center for checkmate

explanation_cn: 双象的元思维：两象分工，分别控制两组斜线，形成交叉控制网；己方王配合压缩，最终在角落完成将杀。比单车更简单，但需要王的积极配合。
explanation_en: Two bishops cover both diagonal colors, forming a crossing net. Own king cooperates to compress the enemy king into a corner for mate.
